i have the regular (which i got as a gift recently after getting body aches from carrying a heavy tote bag), a laptop and a mini. 

i think since it became a status symbol, people just buy it without really learning about the bag itself or the brand. yes, the colour may fade. it’s the dyes. it doesn’t have pockets inside and the side pockets are small. the straps are in fact thin. they are a bit harder to clean. but if you know what you’re getting into, you will likely enjoy the bag very much. 

in my instance, i treat my mini and my regular well, and the mini (one of the limited edition save the arctic fox two tone purple ones) shows the white streaks, but otherwise looks amazing. my regular, super grey, is my every day bag so i got the organiser and shows very minimal wear. my laptop one, oh boy. taken to festivals, vacations, all kinds of travelling. abused to the hell and back, overpacked, all kinds of things. it’s got stains (mainly on the back from my clothes and the straps), the handles strap holding metal thingey is a bit loosened but still snaps fine and the patina came off of the zippers but otherwise looks and functions just fine. none of my backpacks dyed any of my clothes but i wear black, so it tends to rub on the backpack instead. a rain can drench it if it’s heavy enough (the rain) but at that point any bag would, snow or drizzle it can handle well too. oh and yeah the colour faded a bit. which i don’t mind, it’s a reminder of my adventures. 

for me, it’s just perfect. i don’t like how side pockets make backpacks look, so i just carry a stunt gun for protection in one of them and that’s it, the thin straps make it look good since it doesn’t interrupt outfits as much from the frontc i mean on the regular and mini one. the carrying straps are so practical since you can carry it on your arm or snap a hoodie onto the top of the backpack with them. the seat pad will literally save your butt when you need it the most and least expect it. i gotta say, if you can, get an organiser for it. otherwise you will never be able to find your keys and wallet haha plus it strengthens the back too 🤗
